summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its Q1 2026 earnings presentation. The filing includes financial results, forward-looking statements, and discussion of managerial P&L. There are no M&A, activism, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital returns, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change events described. The presentation is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
